deep_dive.title: Gravitational Waves as a Source of Large-Scale White Noise: New Constraints
deep_dive.abstract: A stochastic gravitational wave (GW) background sources a shear in the flow of cosmic fluid which, through non-linear mode coupling, generates large-scale white noise (LSWN) in the kurvature density field. Building on the LSWN framework of our previous work, we derive the amplitude of this GW-induced LSWN and translate the observational non-detection of LSWN into bounds on the production redshift and density of gravity waves. In particular, a minimal constraint on gravity waves with $z=0$ density parameter $Ω_\mathrm{GW0}^*$ in frequency band $f_*$ generated at redshift $z_*$ must satisfy ${z_*}^2\,Ω_\mathrm{GW0}^*<5\times10^7\,(f_*/\mathrm{nHz})^{3/2}$. This, for example, precludes the gravity waves recently detected by pulsar timing arrays \cite{NANOGrav:2023hvm} from being present before $z_*\sim10^8$, long after the quark hadron phase transition. While orders of magnitude stronger than other constraints on gravity waves, this is a minimal LSWN constraint as realistic modeling of early universe gravity wave production, including the granularity of the gravity-wave sources and the LSWN produced by the associated acoustic waves would probably tighten this constraint by orders of magnitude.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 随机引力波背景会通过非线性模式耦合在大尺度曲率密度场中产生剪切并生成大尺度白噪声。本文基于白噪声框架导出引力波诱导的振幅，并将观测未探测到大尺度白噪声转化为对引力波产生红移和密度的约束。得到的限制条件排除了脉冲星计时阵列近期探测到引力波的可能性。该工作为利用宇宙学观测约束引力波背景提供了新手段。

quick_skim.title: Statistical treatment of searches for counterparts of positionally-uncertain astrophysical sources: from flux upper limits to detection
quick_skim.abstract: Rapid growth of the multimessenger and multiwavelength astrophysics had led to an increasing number of observations of the same events with instruments with different point spread functions. In particular pointing instruments with good angular resolution are used to pin-point the source of poorly-localized alert. In case no clear detection of the source counterpart is reached, the interpretation of the results requires statistical analysis. We investigate two approaches using the probability density function of the alert: frequentist and Bayesian, as well as agnostic approach not using this information. We discuss the advantages and problems of all the methods, and compare their reliability and performance. We consider both a simple one-dimensional toy simulations and a realistic use case of full simulations of the follow-up of a gravitational wave event with gamma-ray telescopes. The performance of both frequentist and Bayesian approaches for weak signals is comparable and superior to the agnostic one.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: Provides statistical methods for counterpart searches, applicable to poorly-localized transient alerts such as FRB counterparts

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: The paper develops frequentist, Bayesian, and agnostic statistical frameworks for identifying counterparts of positionally-uncertain sources, directly enabling multiwavelength follow-up of transients like FRBs.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对多信使和多波段时代越来越多定位误差较大的天体警报，论文系统比较了基于警报空间概率密度函数的频率派、贝叶斯派以及不利用该信息的无假设统计方法来搜寻对应体。它从流量上限到明确探测给出了统一的统计判据，并讨论了各方法在低信噪比、非唯一候选体情形下的可靠性与偏差。该方法可直接迁移到快速射电暴、磁陀星爆发等位置不确定瞬变源的对应体认证，因此对相关观测研究具有重要方法学支撑作用。
